notes: Attached source ZIPs are branch snapshots without embedded Git commit identifiers. A null source_commit means the exact archived revision is not asserted.
latest_verified_commit records the upstream default-branch tip observed through the GitHub API on audited_at; it is not proof that the attached ZIP matches that commit.
Versions are transcribed only from the provided source archive metadata/README or the explicitly identified OfficeGen upstream commit. Monorepo package versions are not recommended runtime pins.
Inclusion scope distinguishes curated source material from complete upstream repositories. Installable libraries are not bundled as dependencies.
